title: audit_receipts_list_response
description: Response body for GET /v1/audit/receipts. Mirrors the post-MR-!72 shape produced by Recurse.Gateway.AuditPlane.ReceiptsHandler.render_response/4 (F002 + F004 + issue #44 facets fix). The receipts array contains the F001 split-envelope shape (signed_predicate + outer_container) per ReceiptSerializers.signed_predicate/2 and outer_container/2 (default opts — heavy bytes excluded; the SPA's Verify-Locally flow fetches them on demand). The cursor is opaque server-signed pagination state; null when no more pages. The optional facets object is present iff the request set ?facets=true and carries per-axis counts over the FULL filtered universe (not just the paginated page) per FR-012 + issue #44; SPA dashboard reads these into the left-rail picker.

receipts.description: Page of receipts in the F001 split-envelope shape.

run_id.description: Stable receipt identifier — UUID/ULID. Hoisted to the row's top level for SPA convenience; matches signed_predicate.run_id.

signed_predicate.description: DSSE-bound predicate fields per ReceiptSerializers.signed_predicate/2 default opts. tool_name + tool_summary are non-signed B7 row metadata; everything else is part of the signed bytes.

event_kind.description: Atom-stringified canonical event kind (llm_call, tool_call, ui_query, ...).

machine_identity.description: JSON object with observed-JWT identity fields; backend stores as JSONB (:map). NOT a string — the pre-codegen hand-maintained TS type incorrectly typed this as string|null (issue #48 retiring F2).

principal.description: JSON object with principal kind/subject/account_id; backend stores as JSONB (:map). NOT a string — hand-maintained TS type drift fixed in #48.

signer_kms_key_id.description: Real KMS ARN OR observed:// synthetic marker per F13.

tool_name.description: B7 — non-signed UI metadata; populated for tool_call rows by the importer.

tool_summary.description: B7 — non-signed redacted 1-line tool summary; populated for tool_call rows.

outer_container.description: Non-signed receipt container per ReceiptSerializers.outer_container/2 default opts.

tags.description: Tool-call extractor enriched tags (schema-on-read). Top-level keys are stable (`category`, `tool_kind`, `verb`, `argument_body`, `display_summary`, `scope_kind`, `scope_value`, `target_resources`, `semantic_args`); `semantic_args` is the per-category flex space (e.g. `{verb, subverb, writes, target_paths}` for Bash; `{server, tool, time_window_*, metric}` for MCP). NOT part of the signed predicate. NULL for non-tool_call rows AND for tool_call rows imported before the extractor pipeline existed. Extractor v2 (issue #62, 2026-04-30) promoted `tool_kind`/`verb`/`argument_body` to top-level so Cedar policies and dashboard facets can address them directly without descending into `semantic_args`.

tool_kind.description: Coarse tool family for facets/Cedar attribute lookups: `bash`, `edit`, `read`, `search`, `webfetch`, `mcp`, `agent`, `todo`, `notebook_edit`, `unknown`. Stable across extractors.

verb.description: Action verb. Bash → first command token (`echo`, `git`, `rm`); Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit → `patch`; Read → `cat`; Glob → `glob`; Grep → `grep`; WebFetch → `get`; WebSearch → `search`; MCP → tool name (e.g. `query_metrics`); Task/Agent → `dispatch`; TodoWrite → `todo`; unknown → null.

argument_body.description: Structured action subject. Bash → command minus the verb token; Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Read/NotebookEdit → file path; Glob/Grep → pattern; WebFetch → URL; WebSearch → query; MCP → JSON-encoded input args; Task/Agent → `subagent_type: <kind>`; TodoWrite → `<count> todos`; unknown → null.

semantic_args.description: Per-category flex space; key set varies. See `Recurse.Gateway.Extractors.ClaudeCodeJsonl` moduledoc for the per-category contract.

cursor.description: Opaque server-signed cursor for the next page; null when no more pages.

facets.description: Per-axis counts over the FULL filtered universe (not just this page). Present iff the request set ?facets=true. Each axis is a string→count map; kinds with zero rows are ABSENT from the map (the SPA fills the canonical enum at count 0). Issue #44 (2026-04-30).
